Actual missing-route/status/body and assets need behavior tests. Full files and required include context read; independent extraction/published completeness remains separate.

rationale: FPT/GHEC submodule guide says built-in Pages build automatically pulls submodule content. This describes platform build flow, not proof an arbitrary custom Actions checkout handles submodules or their credentials. Guide limits submodules to public repositories because Pages server cannot access private ones. Preserve service-flow scope rather than universally denying credentialed custom-workflow capability without separate review. Use read-only HTTPS URLs for all submodules including nested entries through gitmodules. HTTPS/source accessibility is not permission to execute upstream code or proof pinned safe content, rights clearance or reproducible recursive checkout. No submodules fetched, gitmodules edited or build executed; linked Git/Jekyll troubleshooting guides remain separate. Missing/private/inaccessible nested content must remain unavailable/error, not a passing site build assumption. Full files and required include context read; independent extraction/published completeness remains separate.
